name: Negative controls (Paris 4)
summary: Same segment, same model (dense_native 16k) and same reference as the Paris 4 PASS, but with the link between prediction and reference destroyed in four ways: reference from another region of the scroll (wrong region), prediction with Fourier phases randomised (same spectrum, no letters), reference cut into 2 mm tiles and shuffled, and shuffled tiles additionally rotated 90/270° with no tile left in place. Scripts: results/negctrl/make_controls.py, make_controls_b.py, run_controls.sh.
headline: No negative control PASSes. Wrong region, phase-randomised and shuffled+rotated tiles FAIL as expected; plain tile shuffle is WEAK (the text-line layout survives a shuffle, so r stays significant) but its stroke recall is at chance, so the letter-level test blocks PASS.

checks.label: positive: dense_native vs true reference
checks.withhold: PHercParis4 publication reservation until 2027-06-25 (scrollprize.org/data_browser/PHercParis4); the numbers are shared only privately with the Vesuvius Challenge team

negative_controls.label: shuffled 2 mm tiles
negative_controls.note: line layout survives the shuffle (1 tile in place); recall − chance CI includes 0
